title: An appoggiatura — unslashed grace note stealing forward
description: A single grace note (D5) before a quarter-note C5, written without a slash and marked graceType stealFollowing — the classical appoggiatura, which leans on the beat and takes its time from the main note. The spec mirror covers the slashed acciaccatura default; this scenario pins the two fields that distinguish an appoggiatura: slash false (rendered — no slash is drawn) and the graceType enum (performance semantics, no visual difference).
